description: This is a Perl script serving as a utility for flashing firmware to a D-Link DSL-G6x4T device, including network discovery, FTP communication, and partition writing.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with additional methods for specific interactions with ADAM2 devices, such as environment retrieval and reboot commands.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends the USER command to FTP server.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables from the FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variables.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device.
